title: EgradxErrorResponse
description: Body of every non-2xx response from the egradx auth, audit and notification endpoints (/egradx/**). Java: com.egradx.core.error.EgradxErrorResponse, built by com.egradx.core.error.EgradxErrors and answered by each library's exception handler (EgradxAuthExceptionHandler, EgradxAuditExceptionHandler, EgradxNotificationExceptionHandler), all extending com.egradx.core.web.EgradxExceptionHandlerSupport. Clients switch on error.code, never on message text; a non-2xx body without error.code is not an EGRADX error (a proxy page, a framework default).

code.description: Stable machine-readable code, e.g. AUTH_INVALID_CREDENTIALS, ORG_SELECTION_REQUIRED, NOT_FOUND. Known codes: error-codes.json.

timestamp.description: When the error was produced, UTC with offset (RFC 3339), e.g. 2026-10-01T08:31:42.740Z.

requestId.description: The request's X-Request-ID, also returned as a response header.

traceId.description: The request's trace (W3C trace id), when the server traces requests: what to look up in the tracing system.

details.description: Present only for codes that carry data a client must act on, e.g. ORG_SELECTION_REQUIRED lists the organizations, AUTH_TOO_MANY_ATTEMPTS gives retryAfterSeconds.
